# JSONata semantic reference

DAGForge's native implementation targets JSONata 2.2.2 and uses the upstream language documentation, observable reference behavior and official language-neutral conformance corpus as its semantic authority.

- Upstream repository: `https://github.com/jsonata-js/jsonata`
- Upstream version: `v2.2.2`
- Pinned commit: `6c7e95fdbf4405a1e741852a7cd8cd985b4305bb`
- License: MIT, reproduced in `third_party/jsonata/LICENSE`
- Local acquisition: `scripts/fetch-jsonata-conformance.sh`

The upstream implementation is not compiled or shipped as DAGForge production code. The license notice is retained because the implementation and compatibility tests are informed by substantial portions of the upstream specification, reference behavior and test corpus.
